text: Clara took a deep breath, her eyes locking onto the rhythmic hum of the machinery. As the blades began their descent, she didn't just rely on timing; she relied on the subtle shift in air pressure that signaled the trap's release. With a fluid motion, she slipped sideways, the cold steel grazing her costume but missing her skin by a millimeter. The audience gasped, then erupted into thunderous applause as she emerged unscathed from the contraption, bowing gracefully to the cheering crowd. Her ambition had not led her too far, but rather to the pinnacle of her career, cementing her legacy as the world's greatest magician.
